name: spellkave_trace_detail
label: Spellkave Trace Detail
description: Read one currently perceived trace by its OWN rev+handle (copy both verbatim from that trace's own row — not the listing envelope's top-level `rev`). The handle is the trace's stable identity: the SAME trace keeps the SAME handle across re-reads, for as long as it stays perceivable, regardless of what else was inscribed since. Returns parsed payload, never the raw payload JSON carrier.

rev.description: The trace's OWN rev, copied verbatim from its row in spellkave_traces — not the listing envelope's top-level rev (stable per-trace handles, freshness gated per trace).

handle.description: Stable trace handle, e.g. t:4 — copied from spellkave_traces.
